title: Control
description: A single control row consumed by control-matrix and policy-gap-review. Obligation-anchored: a control without an obligation_id is either a hygiene control out of scope or evidence that obligation extraction is incomplete.

obligation_id.description: Foreign key into obligation.schema.json. The matrix is obligation-anchored. Absence means the control is hygiene (out of scope) or the obligation extraction is incomplete; in either case the row should be revisited.

risk_id.description: Optional foreign key into the firm's risk taxonomy when the engagement uses one.

control_objective.description: The condition that must be true. Distinct from control_activity, which names who does what, how often, using what system.

control_activity.description: Who does what, how often, using what system. Distinct from control_objective.

control_type.description: Preventive stops the risk event; detective surfaces it after the fact; response is the action taken when the event occurs; compensating substitutes for an absent or weakened primary control.

frequency.description: event-based, real-time, daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or ad-hoc.

owner.description: A named role with accountability (e.g., Head of Model Risk, Chief Privacy Officer, Head of Vendor Management). Generic team labels (e.g., 'Risk team') are not sufficient.

evidence.description: Evidence pointers: system of record output, sample report ID, file location, sign-off log. A policy document is a control statement, not evidence of operation.

last_test_date.description: ISO date of the most recent test. Absence is acceptable for a newly designed control; surface as 'not yet tested' in the matrix tail.

open_issue_ids.description: Foreign keys into issue.schema.json. Open findings against this control. Surfaces in the matrix Open issues column.
